verses.t: And he called to Moshe, and Yahweh spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

“Speak to the sons of Yisrael and say to them: When any person among y'all brings near a brought near offering to Yahweh, from the beasts, from the herd or from the flock, y'all shall bring near y'all's brought near offering.
If his brought near offering is a going up offering from the herd, a whole male he shall bring near; to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting he shall bring it near, for his acceptance before Yahweh.
And he shall lean his hand on the head of the going up offering, and it will be accepted for him, to cover for him.

And he shall slaughter the son of the herd before Yahweh, and Aharon's sons, the priests, shall bring near the blood and dash the blood against the altar all around, which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
And he shall skin the going up offering and cut it up into its pieces.
And the sons of Aharon the priest shall put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.
And Aharon's sons, the priests, shall arrange the pieces, the head and the fatty pieces, on the wood that is on the fire that is on the altar.
And its entrails and its legs he shall wash in water, and the priest shall turn all of it into smoke on the altar: a going up offering, a fire offering, an aroma of rest to Yahweh.
And if his brought near offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a going up offering, a whole male he shall bring near.
And he shall slaughter it on the side of the altar northward before Yahweh, and Aharon's sons, the priests, shall dash its blood against the altar all around.
And he shall cut it up into its pieces, with its head and its fatty pieces, and the priest shall arrange them on the wood that is on the fire that is on the altar.

And the entrails and the legs he shall wash in water, and the priest shall bring near all of it and turn it into smoke on the altar: it is a going up offering, a fire offering, an aroma of rest to Yahweh.
And if his brought near offering to Yahweh is a going up offering from the birds, he shall bring near from the turtledoves or from the young doves his brought near offering.
And the priest shall bring it near to the altar, and pinch off its head and turn it into smoke on the altar, and its blood shall be drained out against the wall of the altar.
And he shall remove its tail end with its feathers and throw it beside the altar, eastward, to the place of the ashes.

And he shall tear it open by its wings without severing it, and the priest shall turn it into smoke on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire: it is a going up offering, a fire offering, an aroma of rest to Yahweh.
